scope: Prospective PFL factorial game-study branch (unapproved; no participants)
inherits: Existing PFL priors PF-P07, PF-P12, prior AB-H INCENTIVE_MECHANISMS5; no historical overwrites

sources.relevance: contests and leaderboards studied; general novelty refuted
competitor heterogeneity and negative responses plausible
even anonymous survey explicit and documented consent

new_priors.claim: Denominator information may improve comprehension transfer in PFL synthetic civic task
new_priors.falsifier: randomized ethical study difference ~0 after equal-duration controls

new_priors.claim: Leaderboard can alter event-selection heuristics and interact with transparency
new_priors.falsifier: no leaderboard or interaction effects in participants

new_priors.claim: Block randomized four-arm schedule can be internally consistent offline
new_priors.limitation: predictable PRNG; requires allocation concealment for human trial

new_priors.claim: Four transfer items measure civic comprehension reliably
new_priors.evidence: C03 20/20 formal QA and blind key

new_priors.claim: Dry-run intake establishes ethically approved human participation
new_priors.evidence: C04 22/22 V8 tests synthetic-only; approval object mock

new_priors.claim: Dry-run cell-mean contrasts estimate causal ITT for real humans
new_priors.evidence: C05 25/25 V8 synthetic; missing data flagged and no causal inference
new_priors.limitation: no real sample, approval, or outcomes
